Online hub: the beasts are the heroes now — QUICKPLAY shows your favorite (or lead) beast at full size, RANKED and PRACTICE VS AI each carry their own beast, your rank badge, points-to-next-tier bar and record live on the RANKED tile, trade slips and leaderboard rows show each tamer's favorite beast, your guild banner hangs as a pennant, and your own head is your beast's portrait.

Online hub: Play Ranked no longer covers your rank and points, the Post Offer bar fits its zone, the guild member count is readable again, leaderboard rows show Steam avatars for tamers you know, and the practice tile's garden art no longer fights the label.

Online hub: the Trade Offers card now shows real posted WANT / FOR offers (beast portraits, poster, time posted) instead of a live-tamer list, and a new View All Offers button opens the full trade board.

PawPad apps rebuilt: Chat, Radio, Effects and Alerts each get a proper screen on the phone — page-style headers with waves, per-channel unread dots and beast/tamer-card embeds in chat (tap a name to see their tamer card), a full radio deck with progress, shuffle/repeat, station switching and stepped volume (Space/A/D work too), timed boosts with depletion bars and a separate always-on skill list, and alerts that group by day, show unread ticks, deep-link to what they're about, and clear with a two-tap confirm. Contracting a beast now files a CONTRACTED alert.
Trade Board filters now use the same angled chip style as the My Beasts and Beastbook filter bars.
The PawPad now actually takes your mouse: hovering, clicking and scrolling inside the phone no longer leak through to the page behind it.
Trade Board filters moved up into the page header beside the ONLINE title (the same spot My Beasts keeps its filters), so the offer grid gets the room the old filter row took.
PawPad apps now fully support keyboard (WASD / Space / R / Z-X) and mouse hover, and the chat input no longer traps your keys.
R no longer opens the radio on top of cycling a page's filters — R is the cycle key everywhere; the radio lives on the PawPad (M, then R).
PawPad apps: the keyboard cursor is now a proper row highlight (brighter row + violet left edge) and a violet rim on buttons instead of a faint ring.
PawPad chat opens on the message box — Enter anywhere starts typing, W climbs into the log, and the channel bar shows its A / D keys.
PawPad radio: the cursor now walks every control (station, transport, volume) with WASD; Space taps what you're on. R tunes, Z shuffles, X repeats.
PawPad app headers: the wave band now drifts and fades out at both ends, and the title seam bars sit centred on the title.
Backing out of a PawPad app (or closing the phone from inside one) no longer flashes the home grid mid-transition — the app dissolves, then the grid fades in.
Online: your name and level now sit centered under your avatar, with the YOU tag above it.
Trade offers show both beasts big at the edges of the slip with the arrow between them.
You can withdraw your own trade offers from the board (they never show ACCEPT on your own posts).
Online hub tiles and columns no longer have cut-off corners; Trade Board filter chips are rimmed in online blue.
Trade offers now show both beasts in framed portrait tiles on the hub slips and the trade board cards.
PawPad app headers: the title seam sits on the text's centre line, and the wave band drifts and runs edge to edge of the screen, and the back button is the house BACK - Q pill.
New element icons everywhere: one clean glyph per element on the two-tone badge (dark fill, bright rim), plus matching bare and parchment variants.
PawPad: opening Chat, Radio, Effects or Alerts now blooms the app's colour out of its tile to fill the screen, and closing collapses it back into the tile.

Online hub: the guild card got a cleanup — your guild's emblem is now a square framed beast tile (the flag/shield is gone), member info reads as one line plus faces, and the weekly goal bar spans the whole card.

Guild emblems can now be a beast — guilds with a beast emblem show that species' sprite on the hub guild card and everywhere in the Guild panel (banner, browse list, previews). Guilds that never picked an emblem show their leader's favorite beast.

Online hub guild card rebalanced — OPEN GUILD is now a proper rounded button sitting on the emblem row's right edge with the member faces beside it, and the weekly goal anchors the card's footer instead of leaving empty space.
The hub's weekly guild goal now explains itself — a small line under the goal name spells out what to do (e.g. 'Clear 75 expeditions as a guild' under EXPEDITION BLITZ).

Your guild page has been rebuilt — the header wears your guild's name, the roster finally shows who's actually around (green HERE, honest last-seen times, and members gone 30+ days fade out), each member's weekly guild XP renders right in their row with a crown on the week's top contributor, and the guild's activity log — joins, level-ups, promotions — is now visible on the page.

Weekly guild goals now live on the guild page itself — THE WEEK panel shows all three goals with plain-words explainers, progress bars, the Monday reset timer, and a gold CLAIM button right there. The Quests panel's Guild tab is gone; goals live in one place.
New guild perk ladder — press the NEXT UNLOCK chip on the guild page to see every working perk stop, unlocked ones lit and the next one marked. Only perks that actually do something are listed.

Guild page cleanup — the 10-row perks list, permanent Danger Zone bar, and duplicate description card are gone. Leave/Transfer/Disband moved to the bottom of Guild Settings, the description is edited there too, and Requests/Invite/Settings are now compact chips in the page header.

Guild page: the plaza now animates in (header, identity band, roster, week and log cascade), activity-log rows ripple into place, claiming a weekly goal flashes the row gold with a success chime, the perk ladder fades open and closed, and the guild LV stamp slams gold when your guild levels up.

The rebuilt guild page is fully playable with the keyboard — W/S walk one cursor down the whole page (header chips, next-unlock chip, announcement, every roster row, the week's goals, and now the activity log too), A/D hop between the roster and the week/log columns at the row right beside you, Space claims a goal or opens whatever's focused, and Q backs out. Hovering with the mouse moves the same cursor, the lists scroll to follow it, and the perk ladder's rows can be walked with W/S before Space closes it.

The Guild page is rebuilt from the ground up: your guild's name and beast emblem lead the page, the roster shows who's really around (and who's pulling the week's weight), the weekly goals finally live on the guild page with plain-words descriptions, a live activity log shows your guild's history, and the perks list became one honest button. Full keyboard play, way less clutter.
Header accent seams are now crisp edge-shaped slabs (the new engine draws real polygons).
The violet selection ring now actually glows — everywhere it appears.
Stat bars, the XP gauge, and the whole fusion ritual (threads, cocoon, flare, result light) now glow; move rows light up in their element's colour on hover.
The corner cuts on My Beasts detail tiles are real chamfered edges now, with a thin frame and a clean element accent strip.
The XP readout on My Beasts sits beside the gauge, so a nearly-full bar no longer hides the numbers.
The My Beasts detail column scrolls edge to edge instead of stopping short of the top and bottom.

Contract Fusion is fully keyboard-playable: the violet cursor ring now shows on the beast grid (mouse too), A/D walk grid, parent slots, FUSE and the fusion list in screen order, Space/Enter/E all slot a beast, Space on a slot clears it, R fuses from anywhere, and Q backs out one step at a time (un-arms CONFIRM before leaving).

The Skills page is one clean view now: five big branch pillars with rounded talent tiles beside a single reading rail that shows what a talent does now, what it does next, and one gold INVEST button. The separate Stats view, the TREE/STATS tabs, the key legend, branch totals and the duplicate footers are gone; with 0 SP the button tells you which level brings your next point, and discounts finally read as discounts (-3% shop prices).

PawPad: M now closes the phone from anywhere (not just the home grid), a second Q while an app is closing gets you all the way out instead of being ignored, and Enter/click right after backing out of an app are no longer swallowed.
PawPad chat: Enter sends and hands the keyboard back, so Q/W/S work right after a message (Enter again to keep typing); switching channel with the mouse mid-sentence keeps you typing.

PawPad: T / C / N and the number keys work from inside any app (hop between Chat, Effects, Alerts or jump straight to a page), E confirms on the home grid, a misclick on the phone body no longer closes the phone, and keyboard moves clear the mouse's parked highlight so only one row is ever lit.

Beastbook: keyboard and mouse stop fighting — a parked mouse no longer yanks the selection back to the tile under it on every keypress, hover highlights go quiet while you keyboard, Q closes Moves/Lore/Mastery/Evolution views (and skips a discovery reveal) no matter how you opened them, W from the top row reaches the filter bar before leaving the page, and the violet cursor ring is centered on its tile.

Beastbook: the dossier cards now wear real chamfered corners with a slim accent strip, the header seam bars and the R CYCLE key-cap match the other pages, the filter chips lift on hover like My Beasts, small text is bumped to a readable size, and element chips use the game-wide element colours with their coloured logos.

Skills: one violet cursor now lives on the page at all times — it opens on the talent you can afford next, follows your mouse or WASD (A/D hop pillars, S walks down onto INVEST and RESET), and Space/Enter/E invests in one press. Reset is a 0.9s hold on F, on the mouse button, or on Space while parked on RESET, with quarter ticks, a cancel blip if you let go early, and a commit chime; the reset button only appears when there is something to reset.
Skills page: hold-to-reset now builds to a proper flash, invests pop the rank pip and light the branch spine, and the page cascades in on open.
Skills: Might, Vitality and Critical Eye now buff only YOUR beasts. Wild beasts and bosses were quietly receiving the same bonuses, so investing in the Power branch was partly cancelling itself out.
Skills: Might no longer double-dips. It was baked into ATK and then multiplied onto every hit again (+9% read as ~+19%). It now does exactly what the card says: +3% ATK per rank.
Skills: investing in or resetting a talent updates your beasts' stats on the spot (HP percentage preserved) instead of waiting for their next level-up.

Skills: Scout now actually does something. Each rank gives light wild waves (the early 1- and 2-beast waves) a 5% chance, 15% at max, to hold one extra wild beast: more XP, more drops, more contract targets.
Fusion: Gene Surge's bonus applies to every gene, and its card now says so. The bonus tapers at high gene values (+2 max at 23-25, +1 max at 26+) so the last few points to 30 stay a mutation story.
Fusion: Mutation Chance from the skill tree now rolls only beneficial mutations, as its description always promised. The natural 5% base mutation is still a coin-flip.

Guild page: keyboard and mouse stop fighting over the cursor (W/S no longer snaps back to the row under a parked pointer), Transfer Ownership opens its member list in front of the settings drawer instead of behind it, the member menu opens on Close rather than Kick, the description, announcement and new-guild name/tag boxes can be entered and left with the keyboard (Space to type, Tab or Enter to leave), and Save Changes plays one chime instead of two.

My Beasts: Multi-Release now works on keyboard (Space marks a beast, R releases, Q leaves the mode), R cycles the element filter and Z/X the sort from anywhere on the page, the violet cursor ring sits centered on every card and control and now shows on the fusion altar slots, hovering a button no longer flickers when the pointer crosses its label or icon, and typing a nickname that contains a Q no longer cancels the rename.

Guild page: Settings is now a full page (emblem beast + colour picker with a live preview, recruiting description and join rules, and a Danger section for leave/transfer/disband) instead of a slide-in drawer; join requests show as a Pending section at the top of the roster with Accept/Deny right there; the header gained a Back to Hub cap and an Invite chip.

My Beasts: the stat bars now glow like the XP gauge, element tags are proper two-tone badges using the same element colours as the rest of the game, hovers and selections wear the page violet so only the cursor ring is bright violet, and gold is reserved for buttons and level marks (a risky fusion now warns in orange instead of gold).

Guild page: the settings view now fades out instead of vanishing, join requests fold away when you accept or deny them (and the new member's row lights up when they land), the level stamp and CLAIM flashes fire on the real beat, and the activity log no longer re-animates every row when a new entry arrives.

My Beasts: fusion altar slots no longer re-pop every time the cursor passes over a slotted beast (the settle plays once, when the beast lands, and the violet ring now sits exactly on a hovered slot), beast sprites on cards are crisper (dropped a blur-causing shadow), and clicking a card flashes its frame without the frame jumping.

Guild page: small text (weekly XP captions, log times, goal blurbs, settings notes) is brighter and easier to read, CLAIMED goals show in gold, the member menu and invite picker match the page's blue look, and the level-up stamp gets a brief glow.

My Beasts: the header's FUSE / MULTI RELEASE buttons and the storage counter are now the same rounded chips as the rest of the game (the counter turns red as you near the cap), an empty collection offers an EXPEDITIONS button and a filtered-out grid offers CLEAR FILTERS instead of dead space, tiny labels were lifted to a readable size, arrows and check marks are proper icons, and the beast dossier's buttons no longer jump under the cursor ring.

My Beasts and Beastbook: walking the keyboard cursor up to the header filters (element, sort, direction, FUSE / MULTI RELEASE) now lights up and lifts the focused button exactly like a mouse hover (previously nothing showed), and the POWER / LEVEL sort chip on My Beasts has its outline back to match its neighbours.
Guild INVITE now lists every tamer the server knows about - not just who's in your lobby. Search by name, see who's online now, their level, and a PENDING tag on anyone you've already invited.
Element icons in filter dropdowns, chips, and tags are crisp again at small sizes.
My Beasts: the small line above a beast's name now reads its rarity instead of repeating the name.

My Beasts and Beastbook: the element, rarity and sort menus at the top are now fully keyboard-playable — W/S walk the options (the list scrolls to follow), Space picks, Q closes, A/D hop to the next menu.

Guild page: roster rows are tighter (88px) and weekly guild XP now reads as one inline stat - a bar and number when you have some, a single quiet line when the week is young; the log folds repeated "Weekly stats reset" rows into one with a count, stops repeating the actor's name, and the settings DANGER slab sizes itself to the actions you actually have.

Online hub: mouse and keyboard no longer fight over the highlight - a parked pointer cannot keep a second row lit while you keyboard. The tamer profile rail is now fully keyboard-playable (W/S or A/D walk Share / Change favourite / Trade / Voice / Mute, Space activates, Q closes; the favourite-beast list takes W/S and Space and scrolls to follow), and the Leaderboards view now shows a BACK TO HUB (Q) chip.

Online hub: locked battle tiles now say OPENS SOON and answer a press with "Not open yet" instead of a silent no; leaderboard scores and trade-board card stamps line up on the right edge, small meta text is a touch larger, and the page says "trade board coming soon" once instead of four times.

Online hub: small grey text (posted times, guild subtitles, stat labels, OFFLINE stamps) is brighter and readable again, the tamer rail LV badge no longer looks like a gold button, red Mute/Withdraw and green Voice/Trade states use the game palette, and the favourite-beast tint matches each element exactly.

Shop rebuilt: goods are now Bag-style cards in SUPPLIES / BOOSTS / SERVER-WIDE / STORAGE sections beside one display case with a single gold BUY; every price shows what you will actually pay, the case opens on the first thing you can afford, and your Contract Ink balance sits on the Supplies row.
